purpose: Teach: 源氏/馬鹿げ/ジャクソン/ニコン/シャレ/一直線/勇者/苔

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今、源氏物語の現代訳、読んでるの。
lines.en: I'm reading a modern translation of The Tale of Genji right now.
lines.style: Gentle opener, like sharing something quietly important. Pace unhurried. Breath easy. A small moment of vulnerability — she's thinking through something as she speaks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。彼の馬鹿げたジョーク、聞き飽きないね。
lines.en: Yeah. I never get tired of his ridiculous jokes.
lines.style: Warm knowing humor. Light, almost affectionate. A half-smile underneath. The ease of someone who has heard this a hundred times and somehow means it each time.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 映画でジャクソン主演のアクション、楽しみ。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to that Jackson action film.
lines.style: Open, genuine interest. Slight lift on the anticipation. Not performing excitement — actually present in the feeling. Natural conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カメラ、ニコンを使ってる人、多いよね。
lines.en: A lot of photographers use Nikon, don't they.
lines.style: Observational, slightly musing. Like noticing something in passing. Gentle pace. Not seeking agreement — just thinking out loud with a friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅前のシャレた店、新しくオープン。
lines.en: There's this stylish new shop that just opened by the station.
lines.style: Brighter tone, some lift in energy. Genuine interest without overselling. The kind of small discovery you want to share. Natural, conversational.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 仕事帰り、家まで一直線、急いで帰る。
lines.en: I usually just rush straight home after work.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly tired but not complaining. Rhythm steady and practical. Like stating a simple fact about how her days go. Grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 子供向けの絵本、勇者が主人公の、人気だね。
lines.en: Those children's books with the hero protagonist are really popular right now.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Pace easy. There's a softness here — maybe thinking of children, or the simple appeal of the story. Reflective, not rushed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お庭の苔、雨上がりが、特に綺麗。
lines.en: The moss in the garden is especially beautiful after the rain.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation, almost reverent. Slow pace. Warm close — the kind of tender detail someone notices when they're paying attention. Trailing softly, like savoring the image.
